summary: On the main deck, Morpheus and Trinity stand behind Tank, who is riveted to the scrolling code. Trinity speaks a terse command directed at Neo: "Run, Neo. Run." The scene offers no further action or response.

what_changes.before: Watching the scrolling code with Morpheus behind Tank
what_changes.evidence: Morpheus and Trinity stand behind Tank riveted to the scrolling code. TRINITY Run, Neo. Run.

event_hint.one_line: Trinity urges Neo to flee while the crew watches the construct from the main deck.

uncertain: Whether Neo obeys the command to run.
What Tank sees in the scrolling code.
Why Morpheus is present and silent.
